description: Use when a coin you need is not covered and you want to ask for it to be added. Free: ask cryptofeed402 to monitor a coin it does not cover yet (covered: BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE, NEAR, AAVE). Logged for human review, not a guarantee. Limit 10/hour/IP; repeats for the same symbol within 24h count once. Example: POST https://cryptofeed402.site/request/asset {"symbol":"LINK"}

symbol.description: Ticker, e.g. LINK (2-15 chars, letters/digits, optional hyphen; leading $ ok)

name: request_asset
title: Request an asset to monitor (free)
